reviews.title: Excellent Mic Case
reviews.comment: I'm using this case for the Shure MV7X and am really happy with it, it's a very rigid hard case, not at all a soft case. I've added some .4" foam to the mic side and it really helps the mic to fit more snug in the case and give it some padding, the case itself doesn't have a lot of padding. The mesh pocket on the other side of the case is perfect to hold 10' XLR cable and makes this an easy way to take this mic on the go, for $25 I don't think there is a better option.
reviews.author: Theo

reviews.title: I almost made stupid choice
reviews.comment: The shell is sturdy and perfect for road trips or travel. My mic investment is surely protected, and I felt so much relief. I was going to just put my mic in a book bag; however, what a stupid choice that would have been. For the value, I probably saved myself another $300 by replacing a new mic.
